sources.document_title: Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier — SS32 THRU SS3200
sources.locator: Page 1, title block http://www.microdiode.com Rev:2024A5, and Maximum Ratings And Electrical Characteristics table, MDD SS34 column
sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer datasheet (retrieved via LCSC's datasheet.lcsc.com PDF host; title block confirms manufacturer identity and part family). MDD SS34 column of the ratings table: VRRM=40V, VRMS=28V, VDC=40V, I(AV)=3.0A, IFSM=80A (8.3ms single half sine, JEDEC method), VF=0.55V max at 3.0A (merged SS32/SS33/SS34 column group), IR=0.5mA max at TA=25C / 5mA max at TA=125C (rated DC blocking voltage, merged SS32/SS33/SS34/SS35/SS36 column group), RthetaJA=70C/W, TJ=-55 to +125C, TSTG=-55 to +150C. Column groupings and boundaries were verified from the PDF's vector table gridlines, not from visual estimation. PDF modDate metadata 2024-09-30; no separate printed revision date beyond the 'Rev:2024A5' code on every page.
